column15: On Dec 6,2022, Beijing Office of the Leading Group for the Prevention and Control of Coronavirus, and Office of the Joint Prevention and Control Coordination Mechanism for the Capital's Strict Management in Entering Beijing decided the new measures for the nucleic acid detection and examination. When entering kindergartens and primary and secondary schools, people must scan the health code and check the negative certificate of nucleic acid test within 48 hours.    See website: https://archive.vn/iobIm.
column24: On Dec 19,2022, the Information Office of the Beijing Municipal People's Government organized The 432nd press conference on the prevention and control of novel coronavirus pneumonia.Beijing has cancelled the restrictions on arrival rate and trans-regional mobility and cancelled the requirement of "three days and three inspections" for employees arriving in Beijing. The regular nucleic acid testing requirements for employees of imported non cold chain goods, bulk construction, housing agency, accommodation services, libraries, cultural museums, art galleries, tourist attractions, production workshops, etc. are also cancelled.But according to a 10-point guideline released on December 7 to improve epidemic prevention and contro,staff working in elderly care institutions, child welfare institutions, kindergartens, primary and secondary schools, inpatient departments of medical institutions, catering (dining), indoor fitness as well as Internet cafes, bars, chess and card rooms, KTV, sauna and other closed places must scan the code and check the 48 hour nucleic acid negative certificate.    See website: https://web.archive.org/web/20230122075354/https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1752651528560939360&wfr=spider&for=pc

column77: On July 29, 2022, the Beijing Municipal Civil Affairs Bureau issued a document granting an additional one-time living allowance of 400 yuan to each person living on subsistence allowances and in extreme poverty. Uninsured unemployed migrant workers who cannot return to work due to the impact of the epidemic, have no source of income for three months in a row, have difficulties in living and cannot be covered by unemployment insurance policies, and are not included in the scope of subsistence allowances, upon their application, they will be granted a one-time temporary relief fund to help them tide over their difficulties. column74: On December 36, 2022, the Joint Working Group of The State Council on the novel Coronavirus Epidemic issued a document implementing the "Class B and B tubes" for novel coronavirus infection. Foreigners who come to China are required to take a nucleic acid test 48 hours before travel, and those with negative results can come to China without applying for a health code from Chinese embassies and consulates. Nucleic acid testing and centralized quarantine for all personnel upon entry will be cancelled. Restrictions such as load factor limits will be lifted, but passengers will still have to wear masks on board.  Beijing will take effect from January 8, 2023.
